1. write the metric, reachability ceiling, smallest cheap instrument, positive/negative decisions, wall-time estimate, disk ceiling, and stop rule;
2. compile/profile the release binary for the target architecture;
3. demonstrate reuse and actual useful activity for the selected measured execution plan on the smallest representative slice;
4. prove resumable checkpoints and bounded temporary storage.

The owner has restored one destination: **a Rust geometric AI using primes,
fixed zeta-zero phases and R4/S3/H4 mechanisms throughout preparation, training,
artifact construction and inference**. Exact `Z[phi]`, chirality/polarity,

conditional score tables, a separate geometric readout and a learned bounded
query-relative memory reader on the same artifact/session path. The reader
selects actual retained token values through prime-addressed postings and
learned relative H4/zeta and query/source features; its write admission remains
deterministic. It is a foundation for direct Rust execution and learning over
prime-addressed lexical context, ordered H4 state and fixed-zeta channels.
It is not the integrated target or a successor that demotes the remaining core
mechanisms. Its source now includes the canonical exact paired coefficient
bridge, signed orientation, an actual additive-window radial carrier and a
typed UOR model address. The bridge is a reversible view of the same H4 roots,
not independently learned paired state. Complete identity lineage, learned
geometric write/nonlinear operators, useful memory beyond eviction and
both alpha capability groups remain explicit integration or qualification work.

Consult the current implementation pointer and

reading within its declared task/window scope. That result does not generalize

joint fitting improves prose while remaining below the coding control. The
general-corpus memory reader also reduces next-piece accuracy against the same
artifact with that reader disabled, including after increasing feature capacity
removes dropped features. Removing zeta can improve the controlled prose score,
so there is no blanket geometric-advantage claim. Word-cue equivalence remains
explicitly opt-in after separate and joint experiments show regressions or
mixed results; exact-cue behavior remains the default. The linked current implementation and recovery records retain exact
artifacts, numbers, controls and limitations. Neither the focused checks nor
these controlled experiments qualify both alpha capability groups.

Use configurable context, training and evaluation windows with cumulative
wall/RAM/storage/thread budgets, useful checkpoints and meaningful focused
checks. Old 15-minute, one-retry, 120-token and 840-second experiment limits do
not govern new development. A resource projection is not evidence that an
architecture cannot learn. Iterate within the authorized budget before
inventing another mechanism to avoid a short window.

All old positive, negative and unavailable results remain valid at their exact
artifact/data/operator/control/budget scope. PR #1124 produced no fitted model
or language-quality terminal; its `RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE_FULL_CONTEXT_CUBE_FIT`

remains required; queue compatibility acknowledgements are not tests.

roadmap.title: [01] Learn contextual phrase and role binding
roadmap.rationale: The retained model admits correct values but can choose the wrong phrase start. This is the nearest observed cause; adding unrelated geometry or more shape-only fits cannot distinguish genuine feature aliases.

roadmap.title: [02] Learn shared state transitions and compositional emission
roadmap.rationale: Reliable binding must become reusable computation and language construction. A growing list of answer-family heads cannot establish a general model.

roadmap.title: [03] Integrate the geometric model and learn general prose
roadmap.rationale: Bounded copy attention and correct short answers do not establish a language model capable of sustained original prose. This issue owns both the integrated native architecture and the missing broad linguistic learner.

roadmap.title: [04] Develop conversation and identity-scoped durable memory
roadmap.rationale: Useful local assistance needs meaning to survive turns, corrections and restarts, with explicit user/project isolation.

roadmap.title: [05] Qualify grounded correctness, conflict handling and abstention
roadmap.rationale: Fluent output must distinguish supported claims from missing or contradictory evidence before it can support reliable reasoning.

roadmap.title: [06] Qualify generalized multi-step reasoning
roadmap.rationale: Executing a familiar arithmetic operator is not flexible reasoning. The model must compose accepted operations and preserve constraints on genuinely changed problems.

roadmap.title: [07] Develop executable Rust coding and controlled workspace use
roadmap.rationale: The coding goal requires working programs and repairs in real context, beyond familiar code-shaped responses.

roadmap.title: [08] Scale quality with complete-path M1 latency, energy and memory
roadmap.rationale: The project exists to reduce energy and wasted compute. Eliminating matrix products is an architectural constraint, not itself evidence of lower energy or useful speed.

roadmap.title: [09] Establish scoped serving, geometry and artifact guarantees
roadmap.rationale: Serving claims need contracts for the operations actually executed, while mathematical proof must remain separate from language capability.

roadmap.title: [10] Complete the native capability API and WASM model runtime
roadmap.rationale: One coherent model must expose its actual abilities to applications before Studio integration can be meaningful.

roadmap.title: [11] Run the native geometric model in GitHub Pages AI Studio
roadmap.rationale: The final user-facing goal is the already developed Studio running our own local geometric model in the browser.

roadmap.title: [12] Qualify, release and iteratively improve the local model
roadmap.rationale: Alpha requires integrated conversation/memory and coding/reasoning on the delivered model; frontier capability is a longer-term evidence-driven objective.
